full_judgment: 4. The defendants contested the suit filling written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint contending, inter alia, that 2.90 acres land of S.A. Plot No.14, Khatian Nos.275, 276, 277 and 278 was Government property, as such, at the time of Revisional Survey (in short, R.S.), the property was properly recorded in the name of Government. 2.14 acres land from R.S. Plot No.8 and 2.52 acres land from R.S. Plot No.9 was properly recorded as khas khatian No.1 in the name of Deputy Commissioner (in short, D.C.), Khulan. Those sale deed of plaintiff dated 13.08.1956 deed No.3729 and deed No.472, dated 27.02.1957 and deed No.337, dated 19.02.1978 are totally false, fabricated and conspiratorial. Those false sale deeds cannot create any title of the plaintiffs in the suit land. Denied to take rent from the plaintiff No.1 on 30.06.2005 is totally false and, as such the suit is liable to be dismissed.
